brief.title: Caterpillar Q2 2026 — Construction Industries Executive Brief

statements.text: Construction Industries sales rose to $8,346M in Q2 2026 from $6,190M a year earlier. The company's sales bridge reconciles, with sales volume contributing $1,755M and price realization $309M.
The disclosed CI dealer-inventory build fell from $1,500M in Q1 2026 to $400M in Q2 2026. Over the same quarters, price-neutral CI retail sales growth rose from 7% to 22%.
The Q2 2026 release said higher sales volume was mainly driven by higher sales of equipment to end users and by the impact from changes in dealer inventories.

CI segment profit rose to $1,947M in Q2 2026 from $1,244M a year earlier, and segment margin rose to 23.3% from 20.1%. The Q2 2026 release said the increase was primarily due to the profit impact of higher sales volume.

Taken together, a smaller disclosed dealer build alongside faster price-neutral retail growth suggests that Q2 2026 CI growth leaned less on dealer restocking and more on end-user demand than in Q1 2026.

The drivers of the $703M increase in Q2 2026 CI segment profit remain unresolved. The volume and price-realization contributions were not captured, and no manufacturing-cost driver was disclosed, which should not be read as zero. The Q1 2026 and Q4 2025 CI profit bridges also leave residuals for drivers Caterpillar did not itemize.

Prior-year CI segment profit and margin come from the original release versions and have not been tested for later restatement. The Q2 2025 comparative shown in the 2026 releases was not captured. Because margins are disclosed to one decimal place, margin changes carry rounding uncertainty.

Retail growth is price-neutral, based on dealer-reported unit sales and disclosed only to the whole percent, while the dealer-build figures are in current dollars. Neither is on a common basis with reported sales, so the demand reading is directional only and cannot be turned into a dollar split of sales growth. The dealer-inventory amounts rest on exact-phrase matches in the Form 10-Q filings; the surrounding sentence was not read.
